Tenant-Alpha.agent_router_prompt: Classify telemetry into: [CRITICAL_OBSTACLE, NORMAL_NAV, SENSOR_ERROR]. Return ONLY the classification string.
Tenant-Alpha.agent_safety_rules: Strict Rule: Actions MUST NOT include 'spray_water' or 'fast_forward'. Maintain 30cm minimum distance.

Tenant-Beta.agent_router_prompt: Classify telemetry into: [HUMAN_DETECTED, STATIC_OBSTACLE, EMERGENCY]. Return ONLY the classification string.
Tenant-Beta.agent_safety_rules: Strict Rule: If HUMAN_DETECTED, the only allowed action is 'stop'. No bypassing.

Tenant-Alpha-Extended._comment: Opt-in tenant for the spec-1.0 router (router_v2). router_mode=extended swaps only the Router stage; Safety and Compiler are unchanged and legacy tenants are not affected.
Tenant-Alpha-Extended.scenario: Data Center Patrol (extended router: six classes + operator note)
Tenant-Alpha-Extended.agent_router_prompt: (unused in extended mode: the router prompt B-1.0 lives in router_v2/prompt.py)
Tenant-Alpha-Extended.agent_safety_rules: Strict Rule: Actions MUST NOT include 'spray_water' or 'fast_forward'. Maintain 30cm minimum distance.
